verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's docs say it groups identical errors into one fault while still letting you step through each individual notice (docs-3). Grouping can be customized per exception by changing the error class, component, or stack trace, or by sending a custom fingerprint (docs-2). A community user independently praises the deduping (comm-1). Missing for 10: an explicit description of the default stack-trace fingerprinting algorithm (only implied by docs-2), evidence of behavior at scale with thousands of duplicates, and in-depth documentation of how custom fingerprints work.
